title: Senior Hardware Engineer - SoC Electrical Failure Analysis (Hybrid)
locations: San Jose, California, United States of America
skills: debugging at asic, sw, hw level
teaser: Join us as a Senior Hardware Engineer - SoC Electrical Failure Analysis, where you will define, design, and verify ASIC and subsystems for Cisco platforms. Lead complex design and development, collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, and drive high-quality solutions. Ideal for experienced engineers with expertise in ASIC and electrical failure analysis.
description:
The application window is expected to close on: 09/29/2026
Job posting may be removed earlier if the position is filled or if a sufficient number of applications are received.

This position requires that you live within commuting distance of our San Jose, CA office and commute to the office at least 3-5 days per week. 

Meet the Team

The Common Hardware Group (CHG) creates innovative hardware platforms central to the AI era, powering Cisco’s core Switching, Routing, and Wireless products for organizations globally. Our innovations in silicon, optics, and hardware platforms—like Silicon One—are shaping the technology industry. We're a global team of creative experts, bringing our unique backgrounds and bold ideas to push boundaries and help each other grow. Because full product development—from design to qualification to production—is within our team, we’re able to think differently, experiment more, and work quickly. Join us to power the future of the digital world.

Cisco Silicon One is the only unifying silicon architecture in the market that enables customers to deploy the best-of-breed silicon from Top of Rack (TOR) switches through web-scale data centers and across service providers, enterprise networks, and data centers with a fully unified routing and switching portfolio. Come join us and take part in shaping Cisco's ground-breaking solutions by designing, developing, and testing some of the most complex ASICs being developed in the industry.

Welcome to the Electrical Post-Silicon Validation Team at Cisco! Our group offers an outstanding combination of a startup culture with the benefits of working for the leading networking company in the world. You will engage in dynamic collaboration with verification engineers, designers, and cross-functional teams, working together to ensure the successful verification and quality of the ASIC throughout its lifecycle.

Operating at the forefront of technology, we work with cutting-edge, high-speed, and power-hungry devices. Our small, but highly influential team thrives in this challenging environment, leveraging our expertise to impact the future of networking technology. With a commitment to excellence and a passion for transformative technology, we are shaping the future of high-performance Networking devices and delivering unparalleled value in every project we undertake. Join us and be a part of a team where professionalism meets impact 

Your Impact

We are seeking a versatile Senior Hardware Engineer to join the team. Your involvement across multiple stages of the product lifecycle offers a unique opportunity to engage with a broad range of technical fields. In this highly visible role, you will play a key part in ensuring our products perform reliably, from pre-silicon validation and post-silicon bring-up through manufacturing support, field issue resolution, and ongoing quality and reliability improvements. 
 

Lead and participate in failure analysis efforts, determining contributing factors and corrective actions 

Lead activities aiming at improving product performance, yield, and reliability 

Define, and refine post silicon validation plans covering functionality, performance characterization, and reliability 

Capture, analyze, and interpret device performance, waveforms, eye diagrams, jitter, BER, PDN measurements, power supply stability and noise. 

Validate system-level behavior under real-world networking workloads 

Contribute to the chip screening test and observability software library (Python, C++) 

Minimum Qualifications 

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field and 6+ years of relevant experience, or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field and 3+ years of relevant experience, or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field and 1+ years of relevant related work experience. 

Relevant experience: Electrical post-silicon validation (Vmin, leakage, PVT characterization, …), SoC failure analysis, Power and signal integrity, High speed mixed-signal design, DFT, SRAM design and/or integration. 

Experience in driving SoC failure analysis efforts. 

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in brining up complex SoC

Experience with electrical diagnostics and measurement equipment (Oscilloscopes, VNA, BERT, logic analyzers...) 

Experience in high-speed physical interfaces 

Experience in design for test (DFT)

Experience in physical and/or logic design

Experience in memory design and MBIST 

Experience with schematics and layout files for sophisticated electrical systems 

Software development experience with Python, C++ or similar language

Understanding of networking fundamentals and protocols 

Why Cisco? 

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
